segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Monday morning. A company discovers an intrusion.

segments.speaker: CISO
segments.text: We had alerts. Too many to investigate in time.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Attackers can use AI to move faster. Defenders need help connecting the clues.

segments.speaker: ENGINEER
segments.text: Give me evidence I can trust, not another mountain of alerts.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: In an isolated training lab, the agentic pentest proof of concept groups scanner findings and uses AI to propose the next action.

segments.speaker: ENGINEER
segments.text: A fixed policy gate. The model never gets them.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: People review the findings. The audit keeps the trail.
